items.title: zhaoxuya520/reverse-skill
items.summary: reverse-skill 是一个逆向工程与渗透测试技能路由包，支持 Claude Code、Kiro、Cursor、Cline 等 AI 编码客户端，集成 IDA Pro、radare2、Ghidra 等核心工具。该包通过 RULES.md 全局路由规则与 MASTER-ROUTING.md 主路由表，自动将 APK 逆向、二进制分析、JS 加密参数破解、EDR bypass、CTF 等任务路由至对应方法论，并检查可用工具后执行可重复的工作流，避免 AI agent 盲目猜测命令。项目支持 Windows、Linux、macOS、Kali Linux 等平台
items.summary_en: reverse-skill is an AI-powered cybersecurity skills router pack that automatically routes AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, Cline) to the correct methodology, toolchain, and repeatable workflow for reverse engineering and penetration testing tasks. It supports 20+ scenarios including APK/Android analysis, binary reverse (IDA Pro, radare2, Ghidra), JS decryption, malware analysis, CTF orchestration, firmware/IoT, and EDR bypass. Prerequisites include Java/JDK, Node.js 22.12+, and Python 3.x, with platform-specific setup scripts for Windows, Linux, macOS, and Kali Linux.

items.title: huggingface/speech-to-speech
items.summary_en: **speech-to-speech** is a low-latency, fully modular voice-agent pipeline (VAD → STT → LLM → TTS) exposed through an OpenAI Realtime-compatible WebSocket API, deployed in production as the conversation backend for thousands of Reachy Mini robots. Its default stack uses Silero VAD v5, Parakeet TDT for STT, Qwen3-TTS for speech output, and a swappable OpenAI-compatible LLM that can run locally via llama.cpp/ggml or through hosted providers. Installation is a single `pip install speech-to-speech` command with platform-specific CUDA/MLX resolution and optional extras like Kokoro-82M and Pocket TTS.

items.title: microsoft/TRELLIS.2
items.summary: 微软发布 4B 参数 3D 生成模型 TRELLIS.2，采用 O-Voxel 稀疏体素结构实现高保真图像转 3D 生成，支持复杂拓扑和完整 PBR 材质。模型使用 16× 空间降采样的 Sparse 3D VAE 编码，在 H100 GPU 上 512³ 分辨率生成仅需约 3 秒，1024³ 约 17 秒，1536³ 约 60 秒。相比传统等值面场，O-Voxel 可无损处理开放曲面、非流形几何和内部封闭结构，且支持 Base Color、Roughness、Metallic、Opacity 等多种表面属性建模。
items.summary_en: TRELLIS.2 is a 4B-parameter 3D generative model that uses a novel "field-free" sparse voxel structure called O-Voxel for high-fidelity image-to-3D generation with arbitrary topology and full PBR materials. It generates assets at 512³ in ~3s, 1024³ in ~17s, and 1536³ in ~60s on an NVIDIA H100 GPU using vanilla DiTs with a Sparse 3D VAE featuring 16× spatial downsampling. Data conversion is processing-free, requiring under 10s on a single CPU for Textured Mesh → O-Voxel and under 100ms on CUDA for the reverse.

items.title: 阿里22B模型实现实时分钟级稳定数字人生成，自定义角色流式交互模型开源
items.why_now_en: Alibaba open-sourced 22B real-time digital human model with streaming interaction.
items.summary_en: TaoMate, a 22.1B-parameter model developed by Alibaba's Tao Tian Group and Nanjing University, enables real-time, stable digital human video generation by combining bounded short-term context with fixed-capacity persistent memory anchored to immutable visual references. The framework achieves 35.0 FPS on 3 GPUs (exceeding 24 FPS playback by 45.8%), delivers a Long Consistency score of 0.9755 and Color Δ of 0.00260, and supports 5–6 minute continuous generation plus 30-minute uninterrupted cases. The model is open-sourced on GitHub and Hugging Face.

items.title: Knowledge-and-Memory-Management v0.0.2: Portable Knowledge Collection & Memory Management
items.summary: Knowledge-and-Memory-Management v0.0.2 版本通过 $AGENT_HOME 环境变量替换所有硬编码路径，实现跨机器可移植。工具支持网页、视频和长篇文章三种来源的知识收集，其中视频采用字幕/转录提取而非音频转写以提升效率与确定性。记忆管理层基于 URL 哈希实现去重，并采用 LRU 策略和时间衰减机制对知识条目进行自动维护。
items.summary_en: Knowledge-and-Memory-Management v0.0.2 replaces hardcoded personal paths with the `$AGENT_HOME` environment variable, making the tool portable across machines, containers, and CI runners. The collection pipeline ingests web pages, video transcripts (via captions only), and long-form articles into `<AGENT_HOME>/collections/<source_type>/` with sidecar JSON metadata. Memory management adds deduplication via URL hashing, LRU-based time decay, and consolidation of overlapping chunks.

items.title: Human in the loop is not a switch: classify the commands
items.summary: 文章提出按"可逆性"而非工具类型对shell
items.summary_en: The article argues that human-in-the-loop controls for AI agents should classify commands by reversibility rather than by tool type, since the problem isn't the approval gate but its inability to distinguish safe reads from risky writes. A deny-by-default classifier approach uses an allowlist for read-only commands (like ls, cat, grep) and automatically escalates anything containing shell operators (&&, |, ;, etc.) to prevent smuggled destructive actions. This asymmetry ensures classifier errors only cause minor user interruptions rather than irreversible damage.

items.title: Show HN: Kota – Bring AI agent CLIs into the same room
items.summary: Kota 是一款开源 AI agent CLI 工具，支持 Codex、Claude Code、Pi、OpenCode、Gemini 等主流 CLI 并列为团队成员，每个 agent 具备持久化身份和基于文件的长期记忆。核心功能包括自动 worktree 同步、Skillpool 技能管理、Telegram 远程控制、人机共享画板及轻量 AI shell。工具由用户因厌倦多窗口复制粘贴而创建，现已用于日常工作、个人项目及 AI 辅助生活。
items.summary_en: Kota is an open-source tool that unifies multiple AI agent CLIs—including Codex, Claude Code, Pi, OpenCode, and Gemini (Antigravity CLI)—into a shared workspace. It gives each agent a persisted identity with file-based long-term memory, self-managed skillsets, and separated worktrees, while enabling inter-agent chat and human-agent collaboration through features like Telegram remote control, auto worktree sync, a shared drawing board, and a BBS.

items.title: microsoft/generative-ai-for-beginners
items.summary: 微软开源课程"Generative AI for Beginners"包含21节课程，教授使用Python和TypeScript构建生成式AI应用的基础知识，支持Azure OpenAI和OpenAI API。课程提供50+语言翻译版本，通过GitHub Action自动维护
items.summary_en: Microsoft's **Generative AI for Beginners** course (Version 3) offers **21 lessons** covering Generative AI fundamentals, with code samples in both **Python** and **TypeScript** for **Azure OpenAI Service**, **Microsoft Foundry Models**, **OpenAI API**, and local offline model execution. The repo includes **50+ language translations** (accessible via sparse checkout), .NET-specific content, and links to additional code samples, community Discord support, and startup resources through **Microsoft for Startups**. Note that **GitHub Models is retiring at the end of July 2026**, with Microsoft Foundry Models recommended as the replacement.

items.title: This CPO regrets that product management exists | Tom Verrilli (CPO of Whatnot)
items.summary: Whatnot是美国历史上增长最快的电商平台，GMV超过80亿美元，其CPO Tom Verrilli提出产品团队应秉持"后悔产品管理存在"的理念。Tom Verrilli曾任Twitch CPO和Twitter产品增长总监，他认为AI正在重塑产品经理的角色，数据科学也因AI发生转变，同时公司倾向于让高级个人贡献者（IC）承担更多实际工作。
items.summary_en: Tom Verrilli, CPO of live shopping platform Whatnot, built the fastest-growing U.S. marketplace in history to over $8 billion in GMV, guided by a product philosophy that "we regret that product management exists." Previously CPO at Twitch and director of product growth at Twitter, Verrilli discusses how AI is reshaping the PM role and data science, the shift toward senior individual contributors doing the work, and what he looks for when hiring.
